Creates each table in `create` with CREATE TABLE as the Schema Editor
writes it. A table in `replace` (which must also be in `create`, with
confirm_replace) is dropped first, losing its rows; any other table that
already exists is left as it is and reported. Each table is its own step,
so one failing doesn't stop the rest.
